notes: Initial AssetReceiver deployment for Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1). Constructor arguments are initialOwner=$owner and previousReceiver=address(0); the factory receives no administrative privileges. Accepts ETH, USDT (0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7), USDC (0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48) and IMD (0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7). Combined lifetime accepted deposits are capped at $10,000 using fixed prices ETH=$2,600, IMD=$9 and USDT/USDC=$1. Withdrawals do not restore capacity. Only 0x047F606fD5b2BaA5f5C6c4aB8958E45CB6B054B7 may withdraw, and all payouts go to that address; partial and full withdrawals remain available while paused or retired. The owner controls deposit pausing and replacement upgrades at a new address. A replacement carries the prior accepted total; existing funds remain at the old receiver and remain withdrawable. Direct ERC20 transfers and forced ETH bypass deposit accounting and may cause actual holdings to exceed the cap. Deployment requires no ETH funding or initialization calls.
